label: Anti-unitary gate obstruction: W33 causal primitive violation bound
motivation: Bhowmik (2022) [arXiv:2211.06107] showed anti-linear anti-unitary gates violate a fundamental causal primitive of spacetime. Machine E's CHIRAL_GATE is anti-linear (it reverses causal orientation). This pass determines whether CHIRAL_GATE violates Bhowmik's causal primitive in the W33 context.

bhowmik_causal_primitive.reference: arXiv:2211.06107 — Reversible computation and the causal structure of spacetime
bhowmik_causal_primitive.statement: Any anti-linear anti-unitary gate G violates causal primitive CP1: the causal order of measurement outcomes cannot be reversed by a physical gate.

w33_context.causal_structure: depth-4 Levi partial order (Pass 4342), NOT Lorentz spacetime
w33_context.chiral_gate_linearity: CHIRAL_GATE is a Z/2Z involution on flag space — it is bijective but NOT linear over any field (it reverses orientation, not a field automorphism)
w33_context.reason: W33 flag space has no inner product structure; unitarity is undefined. CHIRAL_GATE is an order-2 bijection, not an anti-unitary map.

violation_check.reason: CP1 requires an inner product space and Lorentz structure. W33 Levi partial order has neither.

analogue_CP1_for_W33.statement: W33-CP1: No single Levi automorphism reverses the depth-4 causal order.
analogue_CP1_for_W33.status: TRUE — proved in Pass 4345 (CHIRAL_GATE requires 2 automorphisms)
analogue_CP1_for_W33.interpretation: W33-CP1 is a discrete analogue of Bhowmik's CP1. CHIRAL_GATE respects W33-CP1 by using 2 automorphisms.

bound.reason: Each additional chiral reversal costs 2 automorphisms; W33 Aut group has order 32736 = 2^5 x 3 x 341, so at most 16368 chiral reversals are composable before cycling. Practical bound per execution cycle: 1.

conclusion: CHIRAL_GATE does not violate Bhowmik's causal primitive because W33 is not a Lorentz spacetime. However, a discrete W33-CP1 exists and is satisfied: causal reversal costs exactly 2 Levi automorphisms.
